## Download

* **`GameOfLife.exe`** — just download and run (Windows 10 / 11, nothing to install).
* **`GameOfLife-*-windows.zip`** — the same program plus README, LICENSE and the console (Python) version.

Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unsigned program from the internet: click **More info → Run anyway**.

## Controls

| Action | Mouse / key |
| --- | --- |
| Draw / erase cells | left / right mouse button (drag to paint) |
| Start / pause | **Space** |
| One generation | **N** |
| Random board / clear | **R** / **C** |
| Insert selected pattern | **I** |

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/flew96/life-game/blob/{{TAG}}/CHANGELOG.md) for what changed.
